description: Creates a thought and sets its note, type and tags in the same call. Call it when adding something new. Always supply parentId — a thought with no links gets lost in the graph. Search first: a suitable thought may already exist, in which case extending it is the better move.

brainId.description: Brain identifier. Take it from brain_list — never guess it.

name.description: Thought title. Short and to the point.

parentId.description: What to attach it to. Without this the thought is left orphaned.

relation.description: How the new thought relates to that one. Child by default.

name: brain_create_thought
